subject: Social Media
title: Shadow Banning
description: A short lesson to help you apply Shadow Banning.

hook.text: Your posts get zero likes. Nobody replies. But you're not suspended. You've been shadow banned.

buildup.text: Shadow banning hides your content without telling you. You think nobody cares—but nobody sees.

discovery.text: Platforms deny it exists. But developers confirmed: accounts get quietly 'de-boosted' for flags.

twist.text: The ambiguity is strategic. If you don't know you're punished, you can't fight back or rally support.

climax.text: Shadow bans raise free speech concerns. Invisible punishment means zero accountability.

punchline.text: The loudest silence is the one you never hear.
